summary: Configured and verified routed PostgreSQL HA: node2 is the sole writable leader, node3/node4 stream replicas with node4 synchronous. etcd, Patroni, data, routes, firewall rules, and startup persistence are enabled.
actions_performed: Configured and saved VyOS LAN routing and HA-only cross-LAN firewall rules
Configured persistent database LAN addresses and routes
Installed and configured PostgreSQL 16, Patroni, and three-member etcd
Created appdb and verified committed data on all nodes
Enabled automatic failover, synchronous replication, pg_rewind, and replica rejoin
Enabled persistent host access controls and reboot-order safeguards
